name: grill-tab
notes: Interrogate/brief prompts ported from grill_engine.py as chat protocol; Desktop Tab-key UI and auxiliary model routing not reproducible.

name: hades-coding-workflows
notes: Skills-only package (MIT); 3 SKILL.md copied to references/, delegate_task mapped to Claude Code subagents. No MCP server existed to copy.

name: health-data
notes: Oura endpoints + coach rules ported; SQLite store, analysis plans, hermes health CLI and 6h cron not replicated. OURA_ACCESS_TOKEN is a port-chosen name (plugin used a token file).

name: hermes-plugin-netbox
notes: REST calls via curl with same auth scheme; plan/journal/rollback becomes a procedure Claude follows, not a lock. Root SKILL.md (netbox-workflow) copied.

name: hermes-terminal
notes: Hermes Desktop renderer plugin embedding hermes --tui; no tools, no license file. Reference card only.

name: omnivoice
notes: Local TTS via omnivoice Python package (pip index: omnivoice 0.2.1; plugin pins git source). generate() kwargs copied from provider.py, not executed. No LICENSE file (pyproject says Apache-2.0).

name: openspec
notes: Wraps @fission-ai/openspec CLI (npm view: 2.1.1, MIT) and openspec/ files; 11 upstream skills copied. Dashboard/Desktop UI not replicated.

name: skill-router
notes: pre/post_llm_call and tool-call hooks injecting skill suggestions; Claude Code already routes by skill descriptions. Reference card.

name: time-gap
notes: pre_llm_call hook reading Hermes state.db to append an elapsed-time note; no skill-level equivalent. No LICENSE file.

name: tokenwatch
notes: Six Hermes lifecycle hooks for token budgets and freeze; a skill cannot meter or block Claude tool calls. No LICENSE file.

name: web-ollama-cloud
notes: Two Bearer-auth REST endpoints reproduced with curl; request/response shapes from plugin source and README.
